6duperow9: By the time Yann "Ash" Duperow reached U-F20, the war was 11 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. Grey Mill has been won. Yann "Ash" Duperow listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Yann "Ash" Duperow wrote to a wife and a daughter he has never met. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.
Yann "Ash" Duperow cleaned grit from the rifle bolt with a scrap of cloth. The scrap was once the clean part of a shirt.

Fresh from training, Yann "Ash" Duperow still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Lucien "Ash" Winklle, grazed. A bullet clipped Yann "Ash" Duperow's helmet at U-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Otto Won of the Concord (@blaze_won_tv).
Yann "Ash" Duperow was hit in the foot through his boot at U-F20. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Isidor "Saint" Michael of the Concord (@john.michael2877).
Yann "Ash" Duperow waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Yann "Ash" Duperow no longer needed it.
Isidor Duperow put his mother's thimble beside the bunk. Someone who had known Yann "Ash" Duperow helped clear the shelf without saying why.
bannerlordsarp: Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa told the sergeant he was a choir singer. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Yann "Parson" Keggaholic, badly wounded. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. A letter from home found Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa before the night shift. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Face blackened with soot, Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Edmund Raptor was badly wounded. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Otto "Tin" Declan was badly wounded. A letter from home found Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa before the night shift. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa folded it small and kept it close.
Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Emil "Spark" Jmto, grazed.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa was hit in the foot through his boot at Q-F7. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. A letter from home found Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa before the night shift. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa folded it small and kept it close.

Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. A letter from home found Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa before the night shift. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa folded it small and kept it close.

A medic stopped by Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa had gone back to Q-F7. The letter for Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Quentin "Crow" Bannerlordsa kept them.
belka_kld: Karel Kld stepped off the supply cart at P-F10 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Someone asked Karel Kld to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Karel Kld wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Karel Kld got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Karel Kld read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Karel Kld asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
Karel Kld (Hegemony) and Jonas Lynxxactual (Concord) came to the same broken well at the Drowned Farm at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
A loose thread in Karel Kld's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
jcortes_1366: Viktor "Bones" Jcortes arrived on Day 11 as a replacement. The men in P-F7 had been fighting for 11 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Viktor "Bones" Jcortes walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
At P-F7 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Viktor "Bones" Jcortes won the bet. Ulrich Alexandremil was badly wounded.
Viktor "Bones" Jcortes followed a cough through the fog and found the ration party stuck at a junction. For once, a cough improved supper.
Asked what he will do after the war, Viktor "Bones" Jcortes said: 'Be a schoolteacher in Northwick. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
Viktor "Bones" Jcortes reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F7 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Bram Des of the Concord (@des_9419).
Three days with a bandage, and Viktor "Bones" Jcortes is back at P-F7. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
jjheals2013: On Day 9, Henrik Jjheals arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Henrik Jjheals stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Henrik Jjheals flashed a lamp signal to the battery behind the ridge. The answer came back: a single word, misspelled. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F17 with the rations. Henrik Jjheals ate while listening to the revised orders.
Henrik Jjheals tested the telephone and heard someone at headquarters chewing. The line was declared perfectly clear.
Henrik Jjheals and Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev have a secret signal: two taps on the helmet means 'still here'. They use it every night after the flares go out.
The telephone wire to Q-F17 was cut by shelling four times. Henrik Jjheals crawled out and spliced it four times.
At the Ossuary Wood, Henrik Jjheals of the Concord and Albin Mouthfullofr of the Hegemony spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
Henrik Jjheals taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks.
landonbuttvampire: Day 9. The corporal put Bram Landonbuttva beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.

Bram Landonbuttva did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bram Landonbuttva fired back. Wendel "Whistle" Gonzo was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Bram Landonbuttva stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Bram Landonbuttva's name scratched on it. Severin Lilneftrappi kicked it back. It did not come again. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F2, Bram Landonbuttva listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Bram Landonbuttva was hit twice at T-F2, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Norbert Ware of the Hegemony (@the_real_brennan_ware). Bram Landonbuttva was killed at T-F2 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Norbert Ware of the Hegemony (@the_real_brennan_ware).
The papers connected Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva to Bram Landonbuttva. The men took longer to learn Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva's own habits, but they made the effort.
Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: two small boys on a bench, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
A bullet found Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva at T-F2, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Norbert Ware of the Hegemony (@the_real_brennan_ware).
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva. He died on the stretcher before morning.
The House of Landonbuttva sent another. Severin Landonbuttva, brother of Zeno "Shadow" Landonbuttva, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
ledude303: They issued Emil Ledude a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lucky button in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Emil Ledude wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Emil Ledude and Clement Hanginbang divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
A familiar voice came out of the fog in the wrong direction. Emil Ledude waited for the password before answering.
Emil Ledude heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
A bullet went through Emil Ledude's sleeve at P-F21 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Tobias "Crow" Straitonjosh of the Concord (@straitonjosh).

Emil Ledude was hit in the foot through his boot at P-F21. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Matthias Fordlowe of the Concord (@fordlowe). There was no bed for Emil Ledude. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns.
libby_is_hungry: Karel Hungry came up on Day 12 carrying news from Kesselby. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

Karel Hungry fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Edmund Theconcordal was grazed. Karel Hungry ate breakfast without a word. Karel Hungry was hit in the foot through his boot at V-F15. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Emil Brianz of the Concord (@brianz149). Karel Hungry was killed at V-F15 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Emil Brianz of the Concord (@brianz149).
Gustav "Hollow" Hungry joined V-F15 under the shadow of Karel Hungry's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
On sentry duty Gustav "Hollow" Hungry watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Gustav "Hollow" Hungry as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
Gustav "Hollow" Hungry of the Hegemony shouted a joke across the wire at the Drowned Farm. Bastian "Bones" Mma of the Concord laughed before remembering not to. Both lines heard it.
maxlheitzer: On Day 12, Oskar Maxlheitzer arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Oskar Maxlheitzer fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Oskar Maxlheitzer tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at V-F13 is up.

Oskar Maxlheitzer had Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact of the Concord in the sights at the Brickworks for a long second. Albin "Owl" Tombstoneact was lighting a pipe. Oskar Maxlheitzer let the match burn all the way down.

Oskar Maxlheitzer crawled through a gap in the Concord wire and slid into their trench. Severin Montalvao reached for a rifle. Oskar Maxlheitzer was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@m.montalvao_) Oskar Maxlheitzer threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Bram Gadost was down and screaming for a medic. (@gadost144hd)
merazzmu_s: After 9 days of war, R-C4 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C4. Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu has learned to walk bent double.

Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu is number 768. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu carried hot tea up to the front line in petrol cans. Everyone could taste the petrol. Everyone drank it.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu accepted it as a review.
Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu made soup from what the rats left. The men called it the best soup on the front, and they were not joking.
A shell burst short of R-C4 and threw a wall of dirt over Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu. The men pulled him out by the collar, with a cut scalp and a mouth full of earth.
The medic cut the last bandage off Arno "Shadow" Merazzmu's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-C4 the same hour.
quazzii_7: Jonas Quazzii reached V-F9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
A note came over the wire at the Sunken Road, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Emil "Mole" Odin.' Jonas Quazzii sang louder.
Jonas Quazzii (Hegemony) and Emil Hendryx (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Hill 304. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

In the dark of the Concord trench Jonas Quazzii hit Benedikt "Hollow" Adamfoster with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@_.adamfoster._) Jonas Quazzii jumped into the Concord trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Felix "Parson" Matt. The Concord medics will be busy. (@door.matt3555) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Jonas Quazzii was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. Jonas Quazzii waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Jonas Quazzii no longer needed it.
Hugo Quazzii had heard about Jonas Quazzii's courage. At V-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
sam_bowles_: They issued Otto Bowles a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a frozen apple in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Otto Bowles wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Otto Bowles began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Otto Bowles stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

The men at R-R1 heard Otto Bowles call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Cyril "Brick" Paulus of the Hegemony (@chen_paulus11). Face blackened with soot, Otto Bowles spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Cyril "Brick" Paulus was badly wounded. Otto Bowles was killed on watch at R-R1. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Cyril "Brick" Paulus of the Hegemony (@chen_paulus11).
The papers say Henrik Bowles. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Otto Bowles's eyes. Nobody in R-R1 argues.

A round came through the loophole Henrik Bowles was watching at R-R1 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Wendel "Spark" Floooring of the Hegemony (@carpet.floooring). Henrik Bowles had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Oskar Kirov was grazed.
Henrik Bowles held on as long as he could on the stretcher outside the aid post. There were not enough hands, and not enough beds.
Lucien Bowles joined R-R1 under the shadow of Henrik Bowles's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Lucien Bowles waited for that to change. When it did, Rafael Aquaman was gravely wounded.
A grenade burst short of the parapet at R-R1. Lucien Bowles took a splinter in the hand and was bandaged where he stood.
thesenorfry: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Thesenorfry arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F17. Yann Thesenorfry has learned to walk bent double.

A round went through the rim of Yann Thesenorfry's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers of the Hegemony (@chrisspowerss). Yann Thesenorfry smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Matthias Dinomebattic came out for a cup and was grazed. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Yann Thesenorfry watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A bullet struck Yann Thesenorfry below the ribs at T-F17. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Casimir Lordfulgrim of the Hegemony (@lordfulgrim).
A medic brought Yann Thesenorfry half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
There was no room for Yann Thesenorfry. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
Pavel Thesenorfry arrived carrying the family name of Yann Thesenorfry. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Officers came to inspect T-F17. Pavel Thesenorfry polished his buttons with mud, which is the only polish there is.
Pavel Thesenorfry fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Emil Fatherflowst, gravely wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.
tobiasweighill: Henrik Tobiasweighi joined the replacements on Day 9. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Henrik Tobiasweighi wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Henrik Tobiasweighi and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Henrik Tobiasweighi fired. Rafael Szy was badly wounded. Grey Mill is lost. Henrik Tobiasweighi heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Henrik Tobiasweighi had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Benedikt Finland was grazed.
Across from Q-F22, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Henrik Tobiasweighi saw it. Felix Kebapien was grazed.
Henrik Tobiasweighi and Zeno Edge made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Henrik Tobiasweighi read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
Henrik Tobiasweighi fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F22. Yann Next was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
wasdwizard_: They issued Matthias Wasdwizard a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept his mother's thimble in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Matthias Wasdwizard and Bram Cowboy argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Wasdwizard. Matthias Wasdwizard read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Matthias Wasdwizard wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Matthias Wasdwizard mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Matthias Wasdwizard was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Oskar "Ghost" Karlczk and Matthias Wasdwizard divided a parcel using a tin lid as scales. The last crumb needed a second opinion.
Bram Cowboy owes Matthias Wasdwizard so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Matthias Wasdwizard (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Yann Mixtapethepy (Concord) at Verdel Ridge. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
xerod.prime: Dorian "Mud" Prime, a stonemason from Oakmere, was sent forward on Day 11 to fill a gap in N-F8. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Dorian "Mud" Prime watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Dorian "Mud" Prime and Ivo Ursarte made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Dorian "Mud" Prime received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Dorian "Mud" Prime asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
Dorian "Mud" Prime began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
Dorian "Mud" Prime fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Isidor Traill, grazed.
